scope: Only adopted collect/oracle/replay acquisition. No scoring, actualQ, training or held-out execution authorized by this review.

resolved_review_findings.issue: Signal interruption between Popen and recording start_ticks could bypass safe cleanup.
resolved_review_findings.fix: Controller blocks TERM/INT/HUP/ALRM around spawn and identity capture, then restores mask inside cleanup-protected outer try. Mock pending signal at first unmask confirms cleanup receives(pid345,start_ticks123), without creating a process.

resolved_review_findings.issue: Known adapter hashes alone would miss added loader-relevant files.
resolved_review_findings.fix: Every controller verify compares actual adapter recursive file inventory to frozen initial_adapter_sha256 set. Temporary fixture with added_loader.json is rejected before launch.

limitations: Pure fixtures and source review do not predict model/solver runtime or acquisition yield. Existing Linux own-child pidfd preflight is prior evidence; this turn starts no processes.
Controller may only be launched after explicit parent adoption binding these exact sources, successful actual smoke, research48 metadata freeze and runtime/model/original input locks.
Later score/diagnostic/training workers require independent reviews and stage adoptions; acquisition completion alone does not authorize them.
